description.en-US: Eighteen letters of St. John of the Cross in David Lewis's English, with Zimmerman's 1919 corrections, to nuns, to Doña Ana de Peñalosa and others (1581-1591). Lewis numbers them I-XVIII in the order of the 1912 edition, which is not Silverio's order in the Spanish Epistolario, so this is its own book; the Censure on a nun's prayer is in the Opuscula book. Zimmerman's footnotes are not included.
description.pt-BR: As dezoito cartas de São João da Cruz na versão inglesa de David Lewis (1912, revista por Zimmerman em 1919).

sources.edition: The Living Flame of Love, with his Letters, Poems and Minor Writings, translated by David Lewis, with corrections and an introduction by Benedict Zimmerman, O.C.D., London: Thomas Baker, 1919 (first edition 1912). sources.description: Letters I-XVIII. The scan is the best of the three; page headings, page numbers and footnotes are dropped, line-break hyphens joined, and isolated recognition slips may remain.
